lines.en: I walk on, microphone in hand.
My top hat sits above my ears.

lines.zh: 脚步落在电玩厅的地砖上。
lines.en: My feet land on the arcade tiles.

lines.zh: 我在柜台前面踱了两步。
lines.en: I pace two steps by the counter.
My body sways and jingles.
Screen light falls across my face.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地绕展示台一圈。
lines.en: I slowly circle the display table.
I straighten my bow tie a little.
I don't go far — just around here.
Only my footsteps fill the hall.

lines.zh: 我靠到墙边站了一会儿。
lines.en: I lean by the wall for a while.
My shadow walks the wall with me.
I stand holding my microphone.
A thin layer of dust on my hat.

lines.zh: 我的眼珠慢慢转了一圈。
lines.en: My eyes roll slowly around.
The arcade machines are still lit.
There's a paper cup on the counter.
I'm waiting for the next show.
The fan inside me whirs.
I touch the brim of my hat.
Dust gathers in the tile seams.
I'm quiet — always quiet.
You're standing in my hall.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，笑得很客气。
lines.en: I look down at you with a polite smile.
You must be here for the show.
Is my top hat sitting crooked?
You're holding something in your hand.
Don't touch anything on the counter.
You tracked mud in on your soles.
We'll see each other again tonight.
Give me a smile — I'm smiling too.
My shell has been dented.
A dull clang; my frame rocked.
I steady my top hat.
A gear inside caught briefly.
My smile is still a smile.
That made a very ugly noise.
The stitching on my bow tie splits open.

lines.zh: 你留下了很清楚的痕迹。
lines.en: You've left a very clear mark.
Fixing it will cost some effort.
I'm still running normally.
I don't eat; keep it safe.
Your arm must be tired holding that.
I've no interest in such things.
Put it on the counter and step back.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道更像食物。
lines.en: You smell more like food than that does.
Looking at it is enough for me.
It's smaller than my microphone.
Stop waving it around in front of me.

lines.zh: 披萨收起来吧，我闻得到油。
lines.en: Put the pizza away; I can smell the grease.
You bumped into my belly.
My whole frame swayed.
The tiles clattered from the impact.
My bow tie went crooked.
You bounced back a step.

lines.zh: 这台机器很沉，你推不动。
lines.en: This machine is heavy; you can't shift it.
Don't press against my counter.
I reach up and steady my hat.
I nearly dropped my microphone.
Sorry for blocking your way.
I'm here to perform for guests.
This isn't a fitting topic.

lines.zh: 我们只是摆在一起的玩偶。
lines.en: We're just dolls set out together.
Standing together is dignified enough.
Your hat is taller than mine.
We both smile all day long.
Don't knock my microphone down.
When we close, we return to our spots.
Like this, it looks more like a stage.
I'm not very good at such things.
A coin — into the drawer.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉在地上的纸杯。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen paper cup.
You dropped this right here.
I set it straight on the counter.
This thing is a bit greasy.
Too small to grip properly.
I'll keep it safe for you.
This is yours — take it back.
The hall lights have gone out.
Did you hear the doors shut?
I'm free to move now.
Your footsteps are far too obvious.

lines.zh: 我沿着柜台往你那边走。
lines.en: I move along the counter toward you.
No one here will help you.
I've set my microphone down.
The lock is fastened from outside.
You'd best not hide under the table.
I can hear you panting.
I know this circuit well.
Give me a smile.
I'll be right over.
You've backed behind the arcade machine.

lines.zh: 白天我只在展台动一点。
lines.en: By day I barely move on my stage.
The show starts now.
I'm behind the arcade machine.

lines.zh: 屏幕的光照出你的影子。
lines.en: The screens light up your shadow.
I walk neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 你听见地毯上的响声吗。
lines.en: Hear that sound on the carpet?
I rest my hand on the counter's edge.
A bit further and you're in the corner.
I've stayed outside your sight.
Don't run for the supply closet.
The door there doesn't work.

lines.zh: 电玩机的音效盖住我的脚步。
lines.en: The arcade noise covers the sound of my steps.
Your flashlight is dimming.
I like to approach quietly.
Turn around and you'll see me.
This passage only opens at one end.
Just two more shuffles will do.
Two more steps and I'll have you.
You've stopped moving now.
So. Right now.
I lift my hat in greeting.

lines.zh: 我很喜欢你现在的表情。
lines.en: I do like your expression right now.
My arm crashes into you.
The microphone cracks your shoulder.
That one came down heavy.
You're shoved against the counter.
My wrist turned with the blow.
Your armor took the first one.
I drive in hard with my shoulder.
Your back hits a machine.
That blow wasn't all that heavy.
You give half a step; I press on.
My smile stays perfectly polite.
You can't get hold of my shell.
I push you toward the doorway.
My top hat is crooked, but I still swing.
I raise my arm and let it fall.
You rolled across the floor.
That one landed on your knee.
Do you still want to get up?
I pick my microphone back up.
This performance is over.
The lights come up on me.
I stand in the middle of the arcade.
My top hat sits perfectly straight.
All the machines speak at once.
My shadow lies on the tiles.
I adjust my bow tie.
Today's a business day.
I hum a note under my breath.
Everything here is very clean.
I raise a hand in greeting.
Welcome, come on in.
The fire softened my plastic shell.

lines.zh: 落地时脚踝的轴震松了。
lines.en: The landing loosened my ankle joint.
Water works into my gears.
The blast blew my hat off.
A shot embedded in my chest.

lines.zh: 那些光让我的动作变慢。
lines.en: Those lights make my movements slow.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也有极限。
lines.en: I don't eat, but even I have limits.

lines.zh: 电流让我的关节一阵乱抖。
lines.en: The current set all my joints twitching.

lines.zh: 我一边下坠一边还在笑。
lines.en: I'm still smiling as I drop.
